title: Angora Mergvs
note: The town is drawn the way a game draws it, corner on and from above, every roof a dark diamond edged in pink. The creature arrives at house height with its teeth bared, its claws open over the smoke, its tail already burning, and nothing in the street answers it: the windows keep their orange light on, the paths stay white, the pool stays still. The terror is held at the scale of a toy, which is exactly where it works.
facets: Blue in three families over nearly the whole surface, the creature the one warm mass, white kept for the paths and the lit windows
An isometric town seen corner on, the large house filling the lower half, the winged body hung top right between two columns of smoke
The façades blocked flat and edged with a thin pink line, the ground dabbed in two blues, the creature turned wet into wet with the claws drawn last in white

title: Gxd is AFK, We banned it
note: A body is carried down onto a stone ledge, the oldest scheme in painting: the arm hangs until its fingers touch the step, the hands go up against the dark, one mourner weeps into a hand. The body is pink and larger than anyone helping, and the black ground takes most of the canvas and gives nothing back. The title speaks the language of a game server: the god away from keyboard, the ban already issued.
facets: Black over more than half the surface, the group holding the middle in rose and pink, one green robe, orange only at the hands and faces
A single pyramid of bodies set on the horizontal of the ledge, a third up from the bottom edge, the hanging arm dropping down its centre
The black laid dry so the weave stays visible, the bodies turned wet into wet with the white pulled through the pink, the hands drawn last, orange with black stripes

title: sept neuf
note: The pose is unchanged; the clothes and the manner are not. The café table and its drink have been replaced by a Wiggle and an nm13. The eye is a white disc inside a black ring: in Dix the same glass was the claim itself, the document of a woman who looked rather than one who was looked at. Here it is painted shut, and the body has come forward in its place. A bird sits on the stool, drawn with a harder edge than anything alive in the room.
facets: Green over three quarters of the surface and split in two, a dark wall at a hundred and thirty-four degrees against a bright floor at ninety
The wall meets the floor at seven tenths of the height on the left and half of it on the right; the white disc and the bird's head stand at one level
The green scrubbed along the weave with a dry brush, the body turned wet into wet, the dress drawn last in a single yellow line

images.alt: A figure sits in a pale mint armchair in a green room, turned a little to the left, one hand raised with a cigarette in it. The skin is violet and mauve and the cropped hair is painted in dry white strokes. In place of one eye a white disc sits inside a black ring; the other eye is a pale drawn almond, and neither has a pupil. A sleeveless dress is given only by a thin yellow line laid over the body, which shows through it, and a cluster of dark red squares sits at the chest. The near hand rests on the chair arm with white nails hanging over its edge, and the legs cross and end in white court shoes with a red line along the sole. The base of the chair coils in translucent mint loops that the floor reads through. At right a pale bird with a yellow beak stands on the round green top of a black-outlined side table whose foot is built of flat panels, its head turned toward the figure. A dark green wall meets a bright green floor on a diagonal that rises from left to right. A small signature sits in the lower right corner.

title: 7 fam board game
note: One side stands wrapped, each cone clear of the next; the other is stacked two and three high until one head cannot be told from another. Those are the two ways of being a family available on this board, and the game is between them. Nothing has been taken off, so whatever is being played is not the kind of game that ends with a winner. The larger of the two heads has neither eyes nor a mouth; the small one opposite it is all glare.
facets: Warm and cool level at about a third each, cyan the largest family, green under two in a thousand
A board turned corner on, its near point the one corner shown whole, two heads at opposite scales
Lobes turned wet into wet for the heads, the wrappings and the faces drawn last with a thin tip

images.alt: Two figures face each other across a chequered board turned corner on, its near corner meeting just above the bottom edge. At left a large head fills the upper corner, built from overlapping rounded lobes in rose, coral, mauve and ochre with no eyes and no mouth, one white and one yellow ring drawn on it and a pale tapering tube hanging from its underside; below, a dark aubergine jacket with a wide pale lapel line and a long gold wedge down its lower left runs to the bottom edge. At right a smaller head in orange and grey scowls under a dark red cap, the brows knotted and the eyes narrowed, above a wine red cloak with a white collar from which two thin white cords hang into the pieces below. On the board, pink cones each under its own translucent wrapping stand clear of one another; pale blue round heads, some with crossed eyes and some with dots, a small mouth under each, are stacked two and three high and run together into clumps, the densest of them with pointed ears at the right edge of the board. The two sides mix across the middle of the board and nothing stands off it. Behind, a near black opening with softly curved edges runs from the top edge down between two flat cyan fields, and a yellow line, a navy band and a warm plane cross the middle of the picture. A pale signature sits in the lower right corner.

title: Virgil on Virtual Cage (final_final-finalV9)
note: The cage is drawn, not built. A few white lines lay a ceiling across the top and drop two uprights, then stop two fifths of the way down, so nothing is actually shut in. Underneath, the bodies are soft, pressed from the tube and scratched while still wet, and not one of them looks at the lines. The title carries a guide out of the underworld and a file name that has been saved as final nine times over: two promises of an ending, made by something that has none.
facets: Three quarters warm, cool under four per cent, the white wig the lightest point
A white lined box that promises to enclose and stops at two fifths of the height
Grainy pink pressed from the tube and scratched while wet, against flat opaque line

images.alt: A seated figure fills the centre in orange and yellow drapery, one hand raised to the cheek, beneath a long white wig falling past the shoulders. Thin white lines draw an open box around it, its flat grey ceiling spanning the top of the canvas and its uprights running down to the lower edge. Behind, the ground is black and deep red, with a pink rectangular panel at upper left holding a pale outlined chair. The lower two thirds are a dense bed of coral, pink and red strokes. At left a small pale figure with curly hair sits in lavender and cream; at right a larger blonde figure in a pink and grey robe turns inward, a wide pink wing behind its shoulder. Below the centre a smaller figure with grey hair lies back with its legs raised. A dark signature mark sits in the lower right corner.

title: gary grills cooper
note: “Whatever happened to Gary Cooper? The strong, silent type. That was an American. He wasn’t in touch with his feelings. He just did what he had to do.”
facets: Nine tenths warm, two turquoise scratches at waist height the only cool
A frontal order broken by one straight rod falling left from the mouth
Semi transparent touches laid upward in the pan, a near empty brush across the turquoise

images.alt: Centred and frontal, one figure fills the height, its torso and arms built from overlapping rounded balls in purple, olive green and grey white. Tufted brown hair frames a broad tan face with heavy brows; a brown cigar angles down from the mouth. A pale lavender collar opens at the neck. Tan forearms cross at the waist, the hand at right holding a thin dark rod. White shorts and pale tan legs continue to the bottom edge. The ground is orange above and paler yellow below, with turquoise streaks across mid height. A black oval pan heaped with red, orange and olive marks fills the lower left corner.

read: The quotation mourns a man who did not have to know what he felt. The painting gives him back as a stack of coloured balls with a cigar in it, the one straight line in the picture falling from his mouth, and sets a pan of coals at his feet. Grilling is the only thing he is doing, and the title has already broken his name in half to fit the joke.

title: walls of perception
note: What comes out of the mouth is given weight. A column of grains, piled thick enough to cast its own shadow, falls from under the brim into a bowl and is set on the table like something to be eaten. The wall the title names is not behind the figure, it is worn: the brim takes the eyes out of the picture, so the one who is talking cannot be seen to be looking.
facets: Petrol green against burgundy, butter yellow at the ceiling of saturation
A granular column from mouth to bowl as the spine of the vertical format
Yellow piled into ridges that cast their own shadow, thin flat green combed behind

images.alt: A seated form fills the centre. Above it sits a wide-brimmed cream hat with a purple band. Beneath the brim, a dark grey rounded mass carries pink and red vertical marks, and a blue triangular shape hangs below. From this point a broad stream of lumpy yellow grains pours down into a pale round bowl. A charcoal jacket with two curved lapels frames the body against a dark rounded chair back. The upper background is deep teal green; a white band runs along the bottom. A red octagonal cloth covers the lower table, a lavender flower stands at right, and a grey beaded utensil rests at lower right.

title: articulo attack on mandarin
note: The flock is already committed, every wing swept the same way down the diagonal, and the row of figures standing along the boat does not look up. Each of them has an X where the eyes should be, so there is nobody aboard to see it coming. The anchor lies in the corner with its chain beside it. One thin figure at the centre holds the pole, which is the only act in the painting, and it cannot be told whether it is steering or holding on.
facets: Blue, grey, white and black only, contrast carried by value and not by hue
A flock on the main diagonal, upper right to lower left, over a row of figures a third up
A loaded brush flung sideways, bristles splitting, no wing entered twice

images.alt: Deep black fills most of the surface. Numerous elongated bird-like forms painted in blue and white, each with a long beak and streaked wings, scatter across the upper two thirds. Near the centre a thin blue-white humanoid figure grips a vertical pole. Along a horizontal grey boat in the lower third stand a row of small rounded figures built from stacked circles, each marked with an X for eyes. The word STUGOTZ appears in blue letters on the boat's side. At left rises a pale grey triangular peak. Two white anchors and a chain sit at lower left, and thin diagonal lines extend into dark blue water along the bottom.

title: s(t)lop
note: Nothing here separates. The bird and the wall it stands against are made of the same milk, more than one colour on the brush at once, and no contour is ever drawn around the body. The single hard place on the surface is the row of red notches ranged inside the open mouth. Two right angles at the right, a framed panel and a head shut in a box, are all the order there is, and the title slides between what is fed and what would stop it.
facets: Less than one per cent below mid value, mustard gold rather than the pastels at the ceiling
Filled end to end, figure and ground never separated, two right angled units holding the order
More than one colour on the brush at once, every stroke keeping its own ridge

images.alt: Across the left half of a tall surface stands a large bird-like form built from overlapping rounded units in lavender, pale turquoise, yellow and white, with a rounded head at upper left, a long tapering beak extending to the right, a wing of curved strokes below it, and two narrow legs reaching the bottom edge. A row of red zigzag marks runs horizontally at centre. Upper right holds a white rectangle with purple vertical bars; below it a yellow outlined rectangle contains a white head with two eye shapes. Vertical strokes of ochre, blue, pink and turquoise fill the background.

title: penguin is not a friend, only a sinner
note: Up at the narrowest part of the body two dark slits have gathered; the face is there, like a small knot fastened to the top of a mass far greater than itself. The great arcs descending below read as an embrace, and also as two taut wings guarding the chest; this double reading sets up the painting's central tension.
facets: Three or four registers throughout, all the saturated yellow held to the axis of the figure
The centre of the square emptied, the mass piled into the left third
Fan shaped combings from one fast pull, the right third opened with water into a stain

images.alt: Sweeping curved brushstrokes fill the left two thirds of the square, building a tall rounded mass of pale yellow, off-white, olive green and teal, with pale pink patches at the upper left and on the left side below centre. Near the top, short horizontal strokes form two dark elongated marks side by side above a fan of vertical white strokes. Below, yellow arcs curve down both sides around a teal, grey and white core. Three yellow strokes reach toward the bottom edge, one at the lower left and two crossing near the centre. Dark olive brown fills the upper left corner; the right third is thin pale green grey.

title: ciao capo, sono squalo
note: The pointed teeth ranged in the open mouth of the figure on the left stand as the one sharp edge within the softness of the rest of the painting. The title gives this mouth a sentence: hello boss, I am the shark. An Italian and overly cheerful greeting, the opening line of someone introducing himself as a predator.
facets: Five names only, and blue occurs in the bodies alone and carries the whole division
Two vertical masses sharing the frame, three feet at the left and two at the right
One turning pull per egg unit, never entered twice, over a near dry combed wall

images.alt: Two upright figures stand side by side, each built from clusters of overlapping ovoid units in cornflower blue, pale pink, red and white, outlined in black. The left figure fills the left half; its head has an open mouth lined with white spikes, and its body of stacked rounded lumps rests on two thick legs ending in clawed feet. The right figure is narrower and turned in profile, its feet spreading into long toes. Behind them a dark red field covers most of the surface, with a black band down the right edge. An off-white strip runs along the bottom.

title: cellular spleens
note: Below lies a long, flat car, a thick black wheel at each end; it fills the whole breadth of the painting and a large body stands upon it. One foot sunk into the middle of the bodywork, the other braced on its edge, no balance, the stance liable to break at any moment.
facets: More than half grey and white, all colour drawn onto the figure and none of it dominant
Crest, head knot, cellular body and car stacked on one axis, each in a different texture
Long slanted pulls for the ground, one loaded turn for every cell

images.alt: A bulky standing form occupies the centre, assembled from large overlapping ovals in dusky blue, mauve, pale pink, deep red and grey green, all edged in black. Its upper section is a cluster of small loops in red, yellow, green and blue, topped by green and black vertical strokes that fan out across the top edge. One thin arm reaches left to a small dark tip; a curved tubular shape hangs at the right. The form stands on a long dark red body with two black wheels along the bottom. Streaked grey and white fill the background. A black signature mark sits in the lower right corner.

title: cute but unemployed cartoon figure
note: The red ground is a single flat layer from end to end, leaving nothing to fill the space around the figure. In the middle a single-coloured field and a creature standing upon it. The unemployment of the title matches precisely this emptiness, a figure with no role in a scene with no set.
facets: One red over half the surface, every colour of the figure soiled against it
A figure standing on nothing, three of the four corners left empty
One coat of red stopping around the figure, loaded masses set onto it while drying

images.alt: Against a flat red ground that covers the whole surface, a single upright figure rises through the centre. Its head, in the upper area, turns to the left and opens a long jaw showing a row of white triangular teeth. Fanning strokes of black, green, blue and yellow spread from the top of the head. The torso is built from overlapping rounded ovals in grey green, olive, white and black, edged with blue and yellow. Two legs descend to the lower edge, and a limb on the right ends in green and yellow lobes. A black brush mark sits in the top left corner.

title: the family dinner after a night in jaïl
note: Green has wrapped everything, three heads float within this colour; all three issue from the same mass and mix back into it. The one on the left is the lightest and most luminous, almost phosphorescent, its eye sockets hollowed.
facets: Warm under five in ten thousand, the whole event between green and its blue neighbour
Three upright masses darkening into navy pools, with no horizontal line anywhere
Wet into wet throughout, the one hard edge the thick white dome at the left

images.alt: Green covers the entire ground, shifting from bright yellow green at the left to dark blue green near the edges. Three elongated pale forms occupy the field. The tallest, at the left, has a smooth rounded bald head with thin grey lines for features and a long white column of a body reaching the lower left corner. A smaller shape in the centre carries a curled white and lavender head above a dark navy shaft. The third, upper right, tapers downward through stacked blue green ovals. A teal curve crosses the lower centre. A dark blue mark sits at the top right.

title: caprocorn sister: war, plague, earthquake
note: In the middle of the lower half stands a dark green chest, its edges combed in lines, its lid closed; while everything around it is crooked, it is the one geometric unit. Three bodies are ranged around it and the title lists three catastrophes side by side: war, plague, earthquake.
facets: Cool at eight ninths and blue near two thirds, the lightest values unpainted canvas
Three bodies around a cube at three heights, the chest the one angular unit
The night hatched dry over black, bodies in thin half opaque layers that let the weave breathe

images.alt: Against a black ground scored with fine vertical lines, three figures occupy the frame. At left a kneeling figure with a blue and green face, yellow patches around the eyes and an open red mouth rests one knee on a green oval. In the centre a taller standing figure leans a forearm on a thin vertical pole; its head is a plain white oval with grey hair, and its body is streaked with grey, red and blue. At right, a third figure stands with its back turned, its buttocks painted as concentric blue and red rings. A dark green box with yellow-green edges sits at lower centre.
Detail 1 of caprocorn sister: war, plague, earthquake, a painting by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Detail

images.alt: A film shown with caprocorn sister: war, plague, earthquake, by Yiğit Özen

title: baby rights 101
note: Right in the middle, between two dark bodies, a small infant is drawn with a thin red line: a body of rings come side by side, a pair of eyes, a single horizontal notch of a mouth. It stands like a diagram laid onto the flesh afterward, staying upon the paint without mixing into it.
facets: Four fifths neutral, and the only colour belongs to the smallest figure
Three dark bodies with a red baby scheme at the exact centre inside a net of taut lines
Watered black opened by dry brush and wiping, red drawn last with a thin tip on dry paint

images.alt: Overlapping grey and black bodies spread across the full width against a pale blue-white ground. At left a figure with a white ovoid head, hollow eyes and a small dark mouth raises one hand with spread fingers. At right another ovoid white head with an open mouth tops a body whose two arms lift, fingers spread. Between them a large dark torso lies horizontally, legs extending to the lower right and an arm crossing the upper centre. Red outlined circles of varying size cluster at the middle around a red oval. Thin red diagonal lines run corner to corner. Black crosses mark several chests.

title: When the Darkness surrounds, be among those who burn the Great Fire
note: The hand at the end of the arm reaching to the right is left unable to become a fist, the fingers not quite closed; it could be about to strike, it could be reached out to hold something. The title says be one of those who light the great fire, but the palm is empty, nothing burning is visible in the painting.
facets: Warm over two thirds and all of it on the figure, the ground a soiled khaki, brown and olive
One figure filling the frame, its open hand the single gesture
Unmixed colours soiled by rubbing on the ground, thick wet paint for the body, no drawn contour

images.alt: Pink and red rounded lobes build a single figure that fills most of a vertical canvas, streaked with white and orange. The rounded head carries two large oval eyes under heavy brows and a small mouth. One arm reaches to the right edge, ending in a splayed hand with separated fingers; the other drops along the left side. Both legs bend, and two long flat feet spread across the bottom. The ground behind is brushed in dark green, brown and black, with pale peach and a small blue patch at upper left and ochre at the right edge. White marks sit at lower right.
Detail 1 of When the Darkness surrounds, be among those who burn the Great Fire, a painting by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Detail

images.alt: Detail 2 of When the Darkness surrounds, be among those who burn the Great Fire, a painting by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Detail

images.alt: Detail 3 of When the Darkness surrounds, be among those who burn the Great Fire, a painting by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Detail

title: viperella
note: A dark band closes in from all four sides and leaves within it a light green rectangle between lemon and pistachio, setting up a second frame inside the painting. The figure is placed right in the middle of that bright field, standing in profile.
facets: A light inner field against a dark outer belt, the body itself in no colour family
A second frame painted inside the picture with the figure at its middle
Thin horizontal ground letting the weave show, loaded curves for the masses, dark strokes last

images.alt: Standing in profile and turned to the left, a figure built from stacked rounded brushstrokes fills the centre of a vertical canvas. Magenta, purple, olive green, black, white and ochre run through the body in wide curved marks. The head shows a dark cap, a red mouth and a green cheek; one arm lifts at the left with fingers spread. Below, rounded masses form torso, hips and legs, ending in two long dark feet on a pale line. A yellow green panel sits behind the figure, framed on all four sides by dark maroon, grey and black vertical strokes. A small red mark occupies the top right corner.
Detail 1 of viperella, a painting by Yiğit Özen

title: bacchus 2
note: The inside of the stemmed goblet on the right opens not onto a drink but onto a dark pit spiralling down; the distance between drinking and being swallowed closes. The goblet is almost as large as the head, its thin long stem not looking able to carry a bowl of this breadth, ready to topple and no one holding it.
facets: Red a quarter, worked at two ends, the crown above and the border below
The sheet split in two, the head and the bowl of the goblet at the same step of scale
Thin and dry above so the paper shows, thick and wet below, black contours over everything

images.alt: One seated figure occupies the centre against a pale blue-white ground. Its large head, ringed by a thick black contour, is patched with blue, green, yellow and pink, with one eye at the right and a row of teeth in a wide mouth. Red and black looping strokes radiate from the head to the upper corners. The torso and legs are built from rounded units in ochre, pink, blue-grey, mauve and olive. At lower right a wide goblet carries a dark spiral in a red bowl, with blue rounded shapes and a blue hand beside it, above red fruit and red strokes along the bottom.

title: The On-Top Ruler
note: A tower is built of heads heaped one on another and the topmost is the largest of all; between them there is no shoulder or neck, the heads seated directly one upon another.
facets: Nearly half neutral and most of that bare paper, no colour family past a tenth
Heads stacked with no neck between them, the largest of all at the top
Thin half opaque acrylic on thick paper, black lines added last and closing nothing

images.alt: Stacked rounded forms build a tall mass across the upper two thirds of bare white paper. A yellow-green dome caps the top, streaked with red, orange and black scribbles. Beneath it a black oval, a blue-grey disc and a blue oval sit toward the left, next to a yellow circle carrying black bar-like marks. Green and pale green curves fill the right side, edged with red and pink. At lower left a magenta oval encloses a pale yellow area with two dark dots and a dark mouth mark. Grey pencil strokes occupy the top right corner.

title: sin over black matter
note: The right two-thirds has turned into nothing, not even a ground, a halted darkness; the figure is at least twice as small as this void, the single light mass squeezed against the left edge. The body is folded in two, the back making an arch above and ending where the head should be in a lumpy tip, no face set upon it.
facets: Two names only, yellow ochre and a warm black, with one saturated red between them
The body squeezed left, eighty six per cent given to darkness, the centre of gravity off the frame
Overlapping dry passes for the dark, circular rubbings for the body, one flat coat for the red

images.alt: A single figure in yellow, ochre and brown occupies the left third, bent forward so the torso folds over the legs and the head is not visible; one arm hangs down with splayed fingers touching the lower left, and a foot with spread toes rests along the bottom. A flat red triangle sits between the folded limbs at the centre of the body. Pale yellow and white edging runs along the rounded back, widest at its right side. The remaining two thirds are near black, with faint brown and grey streaks and a slightly lighter rectangle in the upper left corner.
An earlier painted version of sin over black matter by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Version

title: the assassination of the crow
note: We look at the body on the blue divan from the feet; the knees push forward and swell into two large lumps, the body foreshortened backward, the head a dark patch so far off it nearly vanishes.
facets: More than half in one red and pink family, the blue bed the only cool block
Two masses either side of a pink emptiness, turned to each other and never touching
Flat opaque fields, feathered dark contours over them, the brightest place made by thinning

images.alt: Two figures divide a horizontal composition. On the left one lies on a blue rectangular bed seen from the foot end, arms stretched out sideways, knees raised as two large pale rounded masses, lower legs and feet extending onto pink flooring, head dark at the far end. On the right a larger figure in purple and brown crouches forward, its head a broad hooked wedge, both arms reaching down to the floor where the hands lie flat. Behind them a red wall carries a framed picture at top centre, a blue panel with a gold leaf form, and a window at upper right.

title: despite transgression
note: An orange body drawn fibre by fibre, vein by vein, sits cross-legged in the middle of the board; the muscles are outside, no layer covering them over, no surface left to hide anything. Against this the face is closed, a green mask in place of the head and a rayed crown about it.
facets: Navy inside the panel against the orange body in front, golden yellow repeated three times
Three horizontal tiers, curved ceiling, framed panel and dark ground, on one axis of symmetry
Matt on absorbent carton, veins pulled wet with a fine tip, the box opened by scraping

images.alt: Filling the lower centre, a symmetrical orange figure built from ropy striated lines raises both arms outward in a wide loop; its head carries a green oval face with two lighter eye shapes and a yellow rayed crown, and concentric rings mark the chest and abdomen. Behind it a deep blue rectangle holds a gold rosette with radiating gold rays and a green leafed stalk descending from it. At upper right a white tufted form with crossed eyes and a stitched mouth hangs on thin orange diagonals. Dark red spans the top, brown the floor, with a coiled brown spiral at lower left.

title: duality of the angelic summarization
note: Two arms are flung to either side and the two hands are not the same. The right one is darkened, almost burnt, its fingers turned to a claw and sharpened and hanging down; the left one is pale, furred, a soft heap close to a wing.
facets: The same form painted twice, cream yellow and grey black, cool holding sixty per cent
A frontal figure prepared for symmetry and broken only at the tips of the two arms
A near dry layered ground, furred loaded pulls for the covering, hard tipped line last

images.alt: One frontal figure fills the surface, shown from the head down with no legs visible. Dark hair spikes outward above a pale yellow face with dark eye sockets, and a black green beard covers the lower head. Below, the body is a broad mass of pale yellow, white and blue in loose vertical strokes. The left arm ends in a pale brushy hand; the right arm lifts toward the right edge, ending in a dark grey hand with spread fingers. A deep blue arc surrounds the figure, going near black above and green at the sides. White scratched lines cross the bottom; a black mark sits top right.

title: victim psycho-logique II : the peachy pharaoh connects with the chair
note: A peach-coloured body stands doubled over on a diagonal running from lower left to upper right, its heaviest mass gathered right at the level of the belly, the legs that bear it thin and long; the borne is heavy, the bearer weak.
facets: Half a single blue purple against the peach yellow body, opposite ends of the wheel
Three units left to right, a hanging toy, a body collapsed on a chair, an empty chair in line
Flat ground in one coat, the body rubbed soft inside a thick black contour, one chair unpainted

images.alt: A tall pink and yellow body bends forward across the centre against a blue and violet ground, its torso marked by two concentric circles. One long arm extends upper left, ending in five thin black-tipped fingers. An olive green head with white eyes and a red striped mouth hangs at right beneath a ribbed orange cone. Two bird legs end in black clawed toes at the bottom. A red four-legged chair sits below the torso; a white outlined chair with a grid seat stands right. A pink line runs from the mouth to the chair. Pale ovoid clusters with X marks hang upper left.

title: guarding holy mountains from malice
note: On the right three blue figures are ranged side by side, the same height, the same stance, arms interlocked; all three have a cross in their eye. Sightless guards have formed a chain.
facets: Five planes in five unmixed colours, green under one in a thousand and all of it in one tuft
An interior built as planes of colour, split in two with the middle left empty
Wide flat coats for the planes, hundreds of separate short pulls for the mass at the right

images.alt: Inside a room with red angled side walls, a blue ceiling, a purple back wall and a yellow floor, a red figure balances horizontally on a thin black pole with a splayed tripod base at left. Its head, with yellow spiked hair, faces right and its hand holds a small striped object. A blue segmented tube sits along the left arm. A pale pink chair floats upside down at top centre. At right a large pink mound covered in brown strokes carries a green bush; three blue figures with X eyes stand in a row before it, arms linked, flanked by two blue crescents.

title: good people helping bad ones (that’s why they’re bad too)
note: How many bodies there are within a white heap cannot be counted; an arm rises up, a leg hangs from beneath it, in the middle two rounds resembling a chest overlap and it is unclear whose limb ends where. The one who helps and the one helped, the one embraced and the one crushed, melt into the same mass.
facets: A quarter still bare black paper, a light cool mass above and saturated warm figures below
A horizontal split, forms that cannot be resolved above, three exactly drawn figures below
Opaque light colour straight onto black paper, wet into wet above, one pass below

images.alt: A large white and pale blue mass of overlapping rounded units fills the upper two thirds over a black support, crossed by orange and ochre streaks and short yellow-green dashes. Two pale discs sit near its top; a separate white ovoid marked with two orange crosses floats at the upper right corner. Three small red and orange figures stand in a row along the bottom edge, arms extended so their hands meet, each with a round head bearing two white X marks and short white strokes below. Two white crosses appear at the lower right. Bare black shows at every edge.
Pencil study for good people helping bad ones (that’s why they’re bad too), a drawing by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Study

title: amor cathedra
note: Two large round eyes are ringed with black rings, the pupils each a dot in the middle, turned directly toward us. For the first time in this series a figure does not shy from looking; the one looked at is now us.
facets: Gold ochre the largest share and all of it at the two edges, lilac a sixth at the centre
Three vertical strips, gold columns at the edges and a dark nest between them
Near dry gold bands, the figure contoured in black, filled lilac, opened with pink and white

images.alt: Lavender and pale pink forms build a many-limbed body that fills most of the sheet, outlined throughout in loose black brushstrokes. Near the centre two large circles hold dark dots, with a third ringed circle beside them and two more ringed circles higher left. Six pale pink and white segmented limbs radiate outward, each ending in small splayed fingers along the bottom and right. A black hatched triangular patch hangs below the central circles. A dark blue oval sits behind the lower half, black fills the upper area, and vertical gold strokes run down both side edges.

title: burningman fast
note: The left half is taken up by a single face; horizontal scratches on its brow, its eyes half closed, its mouth drawn down. At upper right a second, half-scale, paler face.
facets: Two neighbouring warm tones over four fifths, no white, so nothing rises past mid value
Two faces at two scales and two heights, the lower right quarter given over to writing
Red on dark paper that never fully covers, the last line closed by one wide band

images.alt: Red covers nearly the whole surface. A large frontal face occupies the left half, its brow, eyes, nose and downturned mouth drawn in thin pale lines over red, grey and violet washes. A smaller face of the same construction sits at the upper right. Between them a pale hand with four fingers points upward, above thick vertical red bars. Rows of white and pink block capitals run across the lower right, partly overpainted and only partly legible, above a horizontal pink band. Dark navy and black fill the edges, with magenta and violet vertical strokes along the top right.

title: il sbagliato di rompipalle
note: A single neck carries two heads at once; the left one draws near a skull with its teeth ranged in rows while the right one is round, its eyes closed, absent. One dead, one asleep; the shared body binds the two to the same punishment. In the Janus tradition the two faces divide time, one looking to the past, one to the future.
facets: Green over a quarter and all of it around the figure, warm and cool almost equal
One body carrying two heads, the ground passing between them, no shared neck
Wide green passed around the figure and mixed wet at the contour, every region its own consistency

images.alt: Green paint covers the whole background in sweeping strokes. Upper left holds a pink, yellow and dark purple head-like mass with one large sunken eye and a row of white teeth-shaped marks. Upper right, a second rounded head in yellow, white and purple carries two dark curved eyes and a mouth. Below, a broad torso is built from overlapping rounded lobes in mauve, yellow, ochre and white, a circular ochre patch on the left breast, a dark oval on the right. Brown and purple streaked fan shapes fill the lower third. A narrow yellow band with hanging strands runs down the left edge.
Detail 1 of il sbagliato di rompipalle, a painting by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Detail

title: morbid forebodings triggered by childish landscape
note: In the upper right corner stands a tree straight out of a child's notebook: a thin stick of a trunk, a round and puffy greenery at its top. That tree we were all made to draw at school, the most innocent sign saying the world is safe.
facets: An olive yellow body and a blue ground splitting the surface, the dark end crowded by contours
The crown of a tree seated on the raised forearm of the figure
Opaque acrylic on grey carton with its cream left showing, thick contours against short touches

images.alt: Vertical strokes of ultramarine blue, pink and violet fill the background, with lighter blue along the bottom edge and bare canvas showing at the left and top margins. At centre a large yellow-green form built from overlapping rounded lobes and thick black outlines crouches with legs folded to the lower left. A small head with a pink rounded snout and black spiky strokes sits at its top. Its right limb reaches to the upper right, ending near a bushy yellow-green mass on a dark vertical stalk. Three clusters of stiff yellow-green spikes occupy the lower left, lower centre and lower right. Orange patches show at mid-left.

title: wings of abyss
note: Three long beaks rise from the same blue body on separate necks, each looking a different way, their crests flung back at the top.
facets: Warm ground and cool body the other way round, white working as line in both
Three necks from one body turning three ways, the pink figure in the corner tied to nothing
Dry hatched scratches over a dark ground, solid blue on top, white thrown last

images.alt: Three long necks rise from a single blue body at centre right, each ending in a head with a long pointed beak and a white feathered crest. The body carries five concentric circle and spiral motifs in blue, white and dark violet, and stands on thin pale legs with splayed claw-like feet along the bottom edge. Upper left, on a dark maroon field, a pink form made of stacked circles hangs inverted, with spread fingers at top and bottom and two crossed marks near its lower end. The lower third is salmon pink, crossed by thin drawn lines forming trestle shapes.
Pencil study for wings of abyss, a drawing by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Study

title: see u in the other side
note: A vertical border divides the paper in a three-to-two ratio, and the amount of paint carried to each side is the exact opposite of the other.
facets: The same pigments on both sides, opaque at the left and thinned to line at the right
A vertical threshold at three fifths, bodies on one side and marks on the other, no bridge
Acrylic saturating the paper at the left, a thin tip and sparse touches at the right

images.alt: Two interlocking figures built from yellow, orange and cream limbs fill the left two thirds, outlined in blue and red over an ultramarine ground that shifts to lighter cyan below a black horizontal bar. A round pale head with a red band across the eyes sits near the top centre. Dark red discs are scattered at upper left and along the lower edge, and a black diagonal runs up from the lower left corner. The right third is off-white, covered with blue and orange rectangles, arcs and short strokes crossed by thin black diagonal lines. A red circle sits at its lower left.

title: society screwing balance
note: Red stick figures multiply below, more than fifteen, all from a single mould: a round, a vertical line, four sticks. A form repeated this much ceases to be a person and becomes a sign; among them none sees another, some hold hands, some are alone.
facets: Black and white together forty per cent, red carrying every figure and green the two windows
One modelled face set against a dozen figures built from rings
Dry scattered black over exposed paper, every red figure one pass and none corrected

images.alt: Black paint covers a vertical sheet, leaving raw white paper along all four edges. Near the top, two white squares hold green patches crossed by red lines, and between them a red stick figure with raised arms stands beside a grey loop. At upper right a white outlined figure with crossed eyes and a circled chest is drawn at the end of a long red vertical line. A large red and white head with wide eyes and open mouth occupies the left middle above a green horizontal band. Small red stick figures cluster across the lower third beside a green ladder and a red fan of strokes.
Pencil study for society screwing balance, a drawing by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Study

title: How to materialize your loneliness by using an animal in somewhere concrete or technologic
note: On the brow of the enormous head at the left a third eye is opened, and from the two eyes below thick marks descend toward the cheeks. It resembles weeping, but whether what runs is liquid or a scratched-in scratch is unclear.
facets: Warm near two thirds, with darkness and brightness both falling into the right half
One giant head at the left against a crowded vertical structure at the right
Brush for the wide fields, a dry pastel like tip for every line and every word

images.alt: A large frontal head fills the left half of a horizontal canvas, drawn in ochre, orange and pink, with wide almond eyes under black brows, a yellow nose, blue and red lips and pink streaks down both cheeks. The right half holds a blue upright form topped by a dark disc with a yellow curved mark, its centre a black and green panel crossed by red and white bars. A red rayed circle with a small green face sits at top centre. Yellow, green and purple scribbles fill the ground, and block capitals run along the top, down the centre and vertically at the right edge.

title: Century of 0 & 1 / Transhumanism
note: Hands are raised into the air, palms turned to the front; the oldest sign of surrender and of execution scenes waits on the pink body at the left edge, while opposite, a yellow body in profile, mid-step, extends its arms forward and binds itself to the weapon in its hand.
facets: Blue over half the field, the black and white weapon outside the colour order entirely
Three vertical regions, two figures and the instrument that bridges them
Wide circular blue, a soft dry material for the figures, a sharp corrected line for the weapon

images.alt: A blue field of swirled brushwork holds two figures turned toward each other. At left a pink nude stands frontally, both arms raised above the head, legs apart, feet on pink patches at the bottom. At right a yellow figure in profile leans left with both arms stretched forward, breasts marked as circles crossed by lines, green strokes behind its legs. Between them a large black and white firearm with a curved magazine, a cylinder on top and a barrel pointing left. White capitals read NO GENDER above and NO FAMILY IN 21st CENTURY ONLY 0's x 1's below. A 0 marks the top left, a 1 the top right.

title: remixed execution of lucid drowning
note: A greenish body is spread horizontally and no border is drawn between it and the blue beneath; where the body ends and where the water begins is unclear. The arms are open, the legs hang, no trace of resistance. Whether it is sinking or swimming, the painting does not say.
facets: Green level with blue, warm under a tenth and held to the flower clusters
A green mass across the horizontal that never closes into a silhouette
Three tempos at once, a dry scrubbed ground, a wet soft body, a jagged dry column

images.alt: Overlapping rounded masses in pale green fill the centre and form a reclining body whose limb reaches down to a hand at the lower edge. An oval pink and blue face with two large eyes sits in the upper left. Pink and green feathered forms spread across the top. At right a dark green head with bared teeth rises above two large green spheres set on a black mass, with green legs below. A bright blue band runs along the bottom, white and pale grey cover the left, and lavender fills the upper right corner.
Study in pencil and colour for remixed execution of lucid drowning, a drawing by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Study

images.alt: An earlier painted version of remixed execution of lucid drowning by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Version

title: two woman figures sitting at the back of the canvas
medium: Charcoal on the reverse of canvas
note: The stretcher bars and the central rail are visible just as they are; two female figures are drawn in charcoal on the unpainted back face of the canvas, that is the side normally left turned to the wall.
facets: No paint at all, the range running between charcoal black and raw cloth white
The stretcher crossbar dividing the back into two equal panels, one figure in each
Charcoal on unprimed cloth, holding to the crests of the weave with no binder

images.alt: Charcoal drawing on off-white canvas, split into two panels by a vertical wooden stretcher bar, with further bars framing the outer edges and staples running down the left and right sides. In the left panel a nude figure sits on a straight-backed chair in three-quarter view, one arm raised to the head, one leg stretched out to the left, the other bent under the seat. In the right panel a second nude figure stands frontally, arms drawn behind the back, knees bent, feet flat and broad. Both are worked in dense hatching with heavy dark contour lines.
A film shown with two woman figures sitting at the back of the canvas, by Yiğit Özen
images.label: Film
